title: Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure
description:
[SRU] Backport FIPS 140 checksum fix to Resolute

This fix excludes the bundled FIPS 140 snapshot ZIPs from dh_strip_nondeterminism to preserve the certified upstream checksums. This aligns the golang-1.26 package in Resolute with the fix already merged for golang-1.27.

Original approved MP for sponsor context: https://code.launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/ubuntu/+source/golang-1.27/+git/golang-1.27/+merge/514448
commit_message:
Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure

LP: #2174696
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index f9fe1c8..74f1c91 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+golang-1.26 (1.26.8-1~ubuntu0.26.04.3) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Exclude native fips140 module zips from dh_strip_nondeterminism
+    to preserve upstream checksums and fix Go 1.26 validation (LP: #2174696).
+
+ -- Sumit Tiwari <sumit.tiwari@canonical.com>  Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:34:27 +0530
+
 golang-1.26 (1.26.8-1~ubuntu0.26.04.2) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * Widen the TestIssue43124 skip to be unconditional instead of
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 58bb847..297b187 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -99,7 +99,8 @@ override_dh_strip_nondeterminism:
 	dh_strip_nondeterminism \
 	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/src/image/png/testdata/invalid-trunc.png \
 	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/src/archive/zip/testdata/test-baddirsz.zip \
-	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/src/archive/zip/testdata/comment-truncated.zip
+	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/src/archive/zip/testdata/comment-truncated.zip \
+	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140/*.zip
 
 override_dh_shlibdeps:
 	dh_shlibdeps -Xtestdata -Xtest
